newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso extends firmness on bourse rally.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso extends firmness on bourse rally.

text.p: The Mexican peso continued to gain ground against the dollar in mid-morning trade on Monday as foreign investors stepped into the record-breaking bourse, traders said.
"Dollars are flowing into the stock market and some banks are selling dollar positions, too," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 1.1 and one centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.8490/7.8520 and 7.8450/7.8480 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed 0.5 of a centavo firmer at 7.8390/7.8430 per dollar.
